devdoc.details: Each NttManager contract is associated with a single token but      can be responsible for multiple transceivers.When transferring tokens, the NttManager contract will either      lock the tokens or burn them, depending on the mode.To initiate a transfer, the user calls the transfer function with:  - the amount  - the recipient chain  - the recipient address  - the refund address: the address to which refunds are issued for any unused gas    for attestations on a given transfer. If the gas limit is configured    to be too high, users will be refunded the difference.  - (optional) a flag to indicate whether the transfer should be queued    if the rate limit is exceeded

params.canceller: The address trying to cancel the transfer.
params.sender: The original sender that initiated the transfer that was queued.

InvalidPauser(address).details: the pauser is not a valid pauser account (e.g. `address(0)`)

params.peerAddress: Address of the peer nttManager contract.

params.decimals: the decimals of the first TrimmedAmount
params.decimalsOther: the decimals of the second TrimmedAmount

params.transferTimestamp: The timestamp of when the transfer was queued.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

RequireContractIsNotPaused().details: Contract is not paused, functionality is unblocked

TransferAmountHasDust(uint256,uint256).details: Selector 0x71f0634aThis is a security measure to prevent users from losing funds.      This is the result of trimming the amount and then untrimming it.

AdminChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the admin account has changed.

BeaconUpgraded(address).details: Emitted when the beacon is upgraded.

params.chainId: The chain ID the limit is set for.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.msgHash: The keccak-256 hash of the message.
params.sourceNttManager: The address of the source nttManager.

params.index: The index of the transceiver in the bitmap.

params.amount: The amount of the transfer being cancelled
params.recipient: The canceller and recipient of the funds

params.queueSequence: The location of the transfer in the queue.

params.currentCapacity: The capacity left for transfers within the 24-hour window.
params.sender: The initial sender of the transfer.

params.chainId_: The chain ID of the peer contract.

params.fee: The amount of ether sent along with the tx to cover the delivery fee.
params.msgSequence: The unique sequence ID of the message.
params.recipientChain: The chain ID of the recipient.
params.refundAddress: The address on the destination chain to which the                      refund of unused gas will be paid

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

attestationReceived(uint16,bytes32,(byte.details: This function enforces attestation threshold and replay logic for messages. Once all      validations are complete, this function calls `executeMsg` to execute the command specified      by the message.

params.sourceChainId: The Wormhole chain id of the sender.
params.sourceNttManagerAddress: The address of the sender's NTT Manager contract.

cancelOutboundQueuedTransfer(uint64).details: This method is called by the client to cancel an outbound transfer that's been queued.

params.queueSequence: The sequence of the message in the queue.

params.digest: The digest of the message to complete.

completeOutboundQueuedTransfer(uint64).details: This method is called by the client to complete an outbound transfer that's been queued.

params.queueSequence: The sequence of the message in the queue.

executeMsg(uint16,bytes32,(bytes32,bytes.details: This function is exposed as a fallback for when an `Transceiver` is deregistered      when a message is in flight.

params.sourceChainId: The Wormhole chain id of the sender.
params.sourceNttManagerAddress: The address of the sender's nttManager contract.

params.digest: The digest of the transfer in the inbound queue

returns._0: mode A uint8 corresponding to the mode

params.queueSequence: The position of the transfer in the outbound queue

returns._0: - Boolean indicating if message has been approved.
- Boolean indicating if message has been executed.

isPaused().details: Returns true if the method is paused, and false otherwise.

returns.count: The number of attestations received for the given message digest

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pauser().details: Returns the current pauser account address.

params.recipientChain: The Wormhole chain ID of the transfer destination.
params.transceiverInstructions: The transceiver specific instructions for quoting and sending

returns._0: - The delivery prices associated with each enabled endpoint and the total price.

removeTransceiver(address).details: This method can only be executed by the `owner`.

setInboundLimit(uint256,uint16).details: This method can only be executed by the `owner`.

params.chainId: The Wormhole chain ID to set the limit for.
params.limit: The new limit. This is formatted in the normal              token representation. e.g. a limit of 100 for a token with 6 decimals = 100_000_000

setOutboundLimit(uint256).details: This method can only be executed by the `owner`.

params.limit: The new outbound limit. This is formatted in the normal              token representation. e.g. a limit of 100 for a token with 6 decimals = 100_000_000

setPeer(uint16,bytes32,uint8,uint256).details: The nttManager that executes the message sets the source nttManager as the peer.

params.decimals: The number of decimals of the token on the peer chain.
params.inboundLimit: The inbound rate limit for the peer chain id. This is formatted in the normal                     token representation. e.g. a limit of 100 for a token with 6 decimals = 100_000_000
params.peerChainId: The Wormhole chain ID of the peer.
params.peerContract: The address of the peer nttManager contract.

setThreshold(uint8).details: This method can only be executed by the `owner`.

setTransceiver(address).details: This method can only be executed by the `owner`.

returns._0: - Boolean indicating whether the transceiver at index `index` attested to a message digest

params.recipientChain: The Wormhole chain ID for the destination.

returns._0: The resulting message ID of the transfer

transfer(uint256,uint16,bytes32,bytes32,.details: Transfers are queued if the outbound limit is hit and must be completed by the client.

params.encodedInstructions: Additional instructions to be forwarded to the recipient chain.
params.recipientChain: The Wormhole chain ID for the destination.
params.refundAddress: The address to which a refund for unussed gas is issued on the recipient chain.
params.shouldQueue: Whether the transfer should be queued if the outbound limit is hit.

returns._0: The resulting message ID of the transfer

transferPauserCapability(address).details: Transfers the ability to pause to a new account (`newPauser`).

upgrade(address).details: This is upgraded via a proxy, and can only be executed by the `owner`.

params.newImplementation: The address of the new implementation.

isMessageApproved(bytes32).notice: Checks if a message has been approved. The message should have at least the minimum threshold of attestations from distinct endpoints.

isMessageExecuted(bytes32).notice: Checks if a message has been executed.

transfer(uint256,uint16,bytes32).notice: Transfer a given amount to a recipient on a given chain. This function is called         by the user to send the token cross-chain. This function will either lock or burn the         sender's tokens. Finally, this function will call into registered `Endpoint` contracts         to send a message with the incrementing sequence number and the token transfer payload.

transfer(uint256,uint16,bytes32,bytes32,.notice: Transfer a given amount to a recipient on a given chain. This function is called         by the user to send the token cross-chain. This function will either lock or burn the         sender's tokens. Finally, this function will call into registered `Endpoint` contracts         to send a message with the incrementing sequence number and the token transfer payload.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Transfer ownership of the Manager contract and all Transceiver contracts to a new owner.

upgrade(address).notice: Upgrades to a new manager implementation.

userdoc.notice: The NttManager contract is responsible for managing the token         and associated transceivers.
